events.title: Tracking Events
events.payloadI18nHint: Values that look like an i18n key and exist in the language pack are translated into the current language; the original key is kept in parentheses.

analysis.title: Tracking Analysis
analysis.description: Overview, top events and app distribution are fixed to the last 7 days; the trend chart switches between 7 and 30 days.
analysis.ratioBasis: Share = events of this code in 7d / all events in 7d
analysis.loadFailed: Failed to load tracking analysis data

funnel.title: Funnel Analysis
funnel.description: Session-level funnel: session counts and conversion per step in session order; the figures are lower bounds when event sequences were truncated.
funnel.stepsHint: 2 to 8 steps, ordered by occurrence within a session; other events in between are allowed and the pointer never moves backwards. The same event code may repeat (it must occur twice to complete two steps).
funnel.stepInvalid: Select an event code for every step; the step count must be between 2 and 8
funnel.basis: Definition: all steps must be matched in order within a single session; cross-session user funnels are not supported. Rates use the first step's session count as the denominator.
funnel.truncated: {0} sessions had their event sequence truncated; they may have lost later steps, so every step count is a lower bound (the real number can only be higher).

retention.title: Retention Analysis
retention.description: Retention matrix keyed by each user's first-seen day (D0), plus D1/D7/D30 summaries.
retention.matrixLayout: The matrix is a complete {0}×{1} grid; each cell shows "retained users / retention rate".
retention.summaryHint: Each summary merges all first-seen days with weighting (= retained users / users in scope), not an average of the per-row rates.
retention.noteWindow: The latest target day of the matrix window is yesterday (today excluded), so no cell covers an incomplete day.
retention.noteD30: D30 needs 60 days of history (with days=30 the earliest first-seen day is 60 days ago): when no cohort falls in the window the denominator is 0, the backend returns an empty value, and the page shows "Not computable" rather than 0%; 0% is shown only when the denominator is positive and nobody came back that day.
retention.noteLoginOnly: Retention covers signed-in users only: anonymous events carry no user_id and are excluded.
